rationale: The scope hedge “in this sample” was deleted; “may support” became “indicates that structured reflection supports”; and “The moderation analysis should be regarded as preliminary” was dropped. The moderation interpretation also strengthened from “consistent with the possibility that students…may benefit more” to “students with lower prior achievement gained more” and “guided explanation is most valuable.” The replication qualifier was substantially retained as “replication…is needed before generalizing this conclusion,” but the other changes alter claim strength without authorization and commit three listed forbidden moves.
